newsitem.title: USA: LA-Z-Boy sees higher Q3 sales.
newsitem.headline: LA-Z-Boy sees higher Q3 sales.

text.p: LA-Z-Boy Inc said its third-quarter sales may beat last year's by up to seven percent.

"We've seen a pickup in sales during the second quarter that is encouraging to use for the third quarter," said chairman Charles Knabusch in a statement. "Sales order backlogs as of today point to third-quarter sales being up about four percent to seven percent over last year's third quarter."
Sales in the year-ago third quarter, which ended January 27, 1996, totaled $226.4 million.
Earlier Tuesday, the furniture maker reported second-quarter sales rose to $271.6 million from $258.3 million the previous year.

LA-Z-Boy said it makes its initial appearance this month in 46 Sears, Roebuck & Co HomeLife furniture stores on the west coast and in the Chicago area. That number may increase as the retailer adds new outlets.
